sections.heading: Achievement Categories
items: Story – complete main quests and defeat biome bosses.
Exploration – discover named locations, shipwrecks, and hidden camps.
Combat – win naval and land battles under specific conditions.
Crafting – unlock and craft advanced recipes.
Collection – gather every type of resource, fish, or unique item.

sections.heading: Challenges Worth Prioritizing
items: Fast-travel bell placement challenges often reward utility recipes.
Cooking achievements give permanent recipe knowledge; cook every dish once.
Treasure-hunt challenges scale with exploration; do them while questing rather than backtracking.

sections.heading: Tracking
items: Open the Quests panel and switch to the Achievements/Challenges tab to see progress and claim rewards.
Some achievements are account-wide; others are per-save. Check tooltips.
